""" Web scraper for extracting API documentation from HTML pages. This initial implementation provides basic HTML parsing functionality that will be evolved to handle complex documentation structures. The LLM will have access to actual documentation pages through optillm's readurls plugin, allowing it to understand the specific HTML structure and improve the parsing logic accordingly. """ from bs4 import BeautifulSoup from typing import Dict, List, Optional import re # EVOLVE-BLOCK-START # HYPOTHESIS-1: Removing premature isidentifier checks before name extraction will increase accuracy by allowing split()[-1] to properly extract function names from qualified paths # MECHANISM-1: The isidentifier check was rejecting module.function() patterns before extraction; moving validation after split()[-1] allows proper name extraction # EXPECT-1: accuracy > 0.75 # RESULT-1: REFUTED (actual=0.6111111111111112) # HYPOTHESIS-2: Searching all dt elements and multiple code-like tags without restrictive filtering will increase completeness by capturing more valid functions # MECHANISM-2: Documentation uses diverse HTML structures; broader search with post-extraction validation captures more functions without false negatives # EXPECT-2: completeness > 0.35 # RESULT-2: REFUTED (actual=0.275) def scrape_api_docs(html_content: str) -> List[Dict[str, any]]: """ Extract API documentation from HTML content. Args: html_content: Raw HTML content of a documentation page Returns: List of dictionaries containing function documentation """ soup = BeautifulSoup(html_content, "html.parser") seen = {} # Deduplicate by name # 1. ALL dt elements (both with and without sig class) for dt in soup.find_all("dt"): text = dt.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in text and ")" in text: # Extract function name using split()[-1] pattern from top programs name = text.split("(")[0].strip().split()[-1] # Validate AFTER extraction if name and name.isidentifier() and name not in seen: seen[name] = { "name": name, "signature": text, "description": "No description found", "parameters": extract_parameters(text), } # 2. Multiple code-like tags (code, pre, samp) for tag in ["code", "pre", "samp"]: for block in soup.find_all(tag): text = block.get_text(strip=True) # Limit size to avoid large code blocks if "(" in text and ")" in text and len(text) < 300: name = text.split("(")[0].strip().split()[-1] if name and name.isidentifier() and name not in seen: seen[name] = { "name": name, "signature": text, "description": "No description found", "parameters": extract_parameters(text), } # 3. Headers (h2, h3, h4) with signatures for tag in ["h2", "h3", "h4"]: for block in soup.find_all(tag): text = block.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in text and ")" in text: name = text.split("(")[0].strip().split()[-1] if name and name.isidentifier() and name not in seen: seen[name] = { "name": name, "signature": text, "description": "No description found", "parameters": extract_parameters(text), } # 4. Class-based elements (function, method, api) for cls in ["function", "method", "api"]: for block in soup.find_all(class_=cls): text = block.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in text and ")" in text: name = text.split("(")[0].strip().split()[-1] if name and name.isidentifier() and name not in seen: seen[name] = { "name": name, "signature": text[:200], "description": "No description found", "parameters": extract_parameters(text), } return list(seen.values()) def extract_parameters(signature: str) -> List[Dict[str, str]]: """ Extract parameter information from a function signature. Args: signature: Function signature string Returns: List of parameter dictionaries """ params = [] match = re.search(r"\((.*?)\)", signature) if match: param_string = match.group(1) if param_string and param_string.strip(): # Handle nested structures param_parts = re.split(r',(?![^(]*\))', param_string) for part in param_parts: part = part.strip() if part and part not in ['...', '*', '**']: # Extract name, handling type hints and defaults name = part.split("=")[0].split(":")[0].strip() name = name.lstrip('*').strip() if name and name.isidentifier(): params.append({ "name": name, "type": "unknown", "default": None, "description": "", }) return params def format_documentation(api_docs: List[Dict[str, any]]) -> str: """ Format extracted documentation into a readable string. Args: api_docs: List of API documentation dictionaries Returns: Formatted documentation string """ output = [] for doc in api_docs: output.append(f"Function: {doc['name']}") output.append(f"Signature: {doc['signature']}") output.append(f"Description: {doc['description']}") if doc.get("parameters"): output.append("Parameters:") for param in doc["parameters"]: output.append(f" - {param['name']}: {param.get('description', 'No description')}") output.append("") # Empty line between functions return "\n".join(output) # EVOLVE-BLOCK-END # Example usage and test if __name__ == "__main__": # Sample HTML for testing basic functionality sample_html = """
json.dumps(obj, indent=2)

Serialize obj to a JSON formatted string.

json.loads(s)

Deserialize s to a Python object.

""" docs = scrape_api_docs(sample_html) print(format_documentation(docs)) print(f"\nExtracted {len(docs)} functions")
